parsed.explanation: Lawful expression and no criminalisation of trans identity, with no documented fatal violence since 1997, hold this above the high-risk tiers. But the dossier shows a tier-1 state exposure: national birth-sex prison placement with documented sexual assault of trans women, no placement policy, unit, or court relief (2020). Official hostility is current — femicide-protection exclusion justified by officials, government tolerance of bias crimes, no accommodation or hate-crime protection, hostile legislative bills (censorship, anti-'gender identity disorder'), conversion practices normalised. Documents must show birth sex, exposing the outed visitor to ID scrutiny with no recourse. Society is religiously conservative; no violence rate exists, so current street risk is undocumented rather than absent. Net: unremedied universal exposure plus official hostility, but no criminalisation or organised targeting — Elevated Risk.
